decision.what: A reaction is its own line {react:{at, session, re, emoji, from}}; an empty emoji removes it; latest per sender per bubble wins (SMS tap-back: one per person).
decision.alternative: a chat line with a kind:react field - rejected: every reader of chat lines would have to learn to skip it.

decision.what: An assistant reacts by making its WHOLE reply a single emoji; Sessions.heard() turns that into a react line on the owner's line. No new tool: the fast assistant has no tools at all.
decision.alternative: an MCP tool session_react - the fast assistant runs with tools: [] so it could never call it.

log.msg: take_worktree refused (all 3 taken); made a private one with node Server/worktree-up.mjs chat-reactions (port 61966).

decision.what: The fast reply waits 8 s after the owner spoke (SERVEX_SESSION_FAST_WAIT_MS); if the smart one has answered or reacted to that line by then, the fast reply is dropped.
decision.alternative: 5 s - too short: the smart one gathers for 1.5 s, then thinks with the full Claude Code preset, so it would almost never win.

decision.what: Owner reactions reach the assistants as a plain note line prepended to their next prompt; a question-mark reaction on an assistant line wakes the smart one at once to explain.
decision.alternative: only the next prompt for everything - a ? then waits until the owner speaks again, which defeats it.

decision.what: Reactions are enabled on a ChatPanel that can save them (a host react() or its own local list); a card-fed panel with no react() gets none.
decision.alternative: everywhere, local only - a reaction that vanishes on reload would lie.

decision.what: The avatar replaces the role-name label: a round icon floated at the bubble start, tinted with the role colour, name in its tooltip. The via mark moved to a small faint trailing icon after the last word.
decision.alternative: keep the name word beside the icon - the owner asked for the icon to double as the name.

log.msg: Server proof: 9/9 pass (scratchpad sessions-test.mjs, fake host): smart lone emoji -> react line, fast dropped when smart answered first, fast held then released, fast lone emoji -> react, owner ? wakes smart with the note, owner 👍 prepended to next prompt, non-emoji refused.

decision.what: Threaded replies: a line with re + thread: true is drawn in a folded 'N replies' thread under its parent, one level deep; the voice session keeps re/thread on the owner line, tells both assistants which line it answers, and threads their answers too.
decision.alternative: re alone as the thread marker - rejected: every assistant reply already carries re, so the whole chat would fold into threads.
